diff --git a/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py b/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
index a282c36..11960ad 100644
--- a/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
+++ b/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import lists
+import web
 
 
 def test_process_seeds():
@@ -11,3 +12,48 @@ def test_process_seeds():
     assert f({"key": "/books/OL1M"}) == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
     assert f("/subjects/love") == "subject:love"
     assert f("subject:love") == "subject:love"
+
+
+def test_list_record_uses_post_body_without_query(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: (
+            b'name=Body+list&name=Later+list&description=Body+description'
+            b'&seeds--0--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL1M&seeds--1--key='
+            b'&seeds--2--key=%2Fsubjects%2Flove'
+        ),
+    )
+
+    def unexpected_query(**kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError('POST body must not read query parameters')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', unexpected_query)
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.key is None
+    assert record.name == 'Body list'
+    assert record.description == 'Body description'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}, 'love']
+
+
+def test_list_record_query_fallback(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'')
+
+    def query(**defaults):
+        assert defaults == {'key': None, 'name': '', 'description': '', 'seeds': []}
+        return web.storage({**defaults, 'name': 'Query list', 'seeds--0--key': '/books/OL1M'})
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', query)
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.name == 'Query list'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_ignores_invalid_indexed_seeds(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: b'name=List&seeds--0--other=value&seeds--1--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL1M',
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **kwargs: None)
+    assert lists.ListRecord.from_input().seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
